# Classification Systems

This area groups classification systems and frameworks used to stratify patients or categorize clinical data within the corpus. It currently covers medical classification systems, which include international frameworks utilized in the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD) reports for the age-based and clinical stratification of patients with inflammatory bowel disease.

## Pages

- [[entities/classification-systems/medical/index|Medical]] — Medical classification frameworks used to stratify patients or categorize clinical data, such as the Montreal classification for inflammatory bowel disease.
